content.value_statement: Annual planning often leaves users with broad goals that are hard to act on. This skill turns a 2026 vision into process goals, weekly checklists, and review routines.
actual_capabilities: Guides four discovery rounds about current state, vision, strategy, and process.
Converts annual outcomes into quarterly milestones and daily behaviors.
Creates named Markdown planning artifacts when file tools are available.
Supports weekly review prompts for process goal tracking.
Adapts questions for Claude Code structured prompts or conversational chat.
limitations: Requires honest user input; it cannot infer private context without being told.
May write local Markdown files only when the agent has filesystem tools and user approval.
Referenced template files are not present in the scanned package.
Does not replace professional financial, legal, medical, or mental health advice.

use_cases.title: Plan an Executive Year
use_cases.description: Build a 2026 plan with one north star, quarterly milestones, and weekly operating habits.

use_cases.title: Turn Goals Into Daily Actions
use_cases.description: Convert broad outcomes into controllable behaviors that can be checked every day.

use_cases.title: Run Weekly Reviews
use_cases.description: Review progress, identify blockers, and create the next week of process goals.

prompt_templates.title: Start a 2026 Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a first planning session.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use 2026-coach to help me plan my year. Ask discovery questions one at a time and summarize my current state before setting goals.

prompt_templates.title: Convert One Outcome Goal
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn a broad goal into process goals.
prompt_templates.prompt: My main 2026 outcome is [goal]. Convert it into quarterly milestones, weekly process goals, and daily behaviors I control.

prompt_templates.title: Create Weekly Accountability
prompt_templates.scenario: Build a review and checklist routine.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the coaching workflow to create my first weekly checklist. Include daily targets, a Sunday review, and a short blocker review.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Full Operating Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the complete 2026-coach workflow. After discovery, create an annual plan, coaching context, and first weekly process plan.

output_examples.input: I want to grow my consulting business in 2026.
output_examples.output: A coaching response identifies one annual revenue target, quarterly milestones, and daily outreach behaviors.

output_examples.input: I know my goal, but I do not know what to do daily.
output_examples.output: The skill maps the goal to controllable actions, weekly totals, and a daily checklist.

output_examples.input: I need a weekly review for my process goals.
output_examples.output: The response asks review questions, captures lessons, and drafts next week based on progress and blockers.

best_practices: Share concrete constraints, available time, and the one metric that matters most.
Review process goals weekly and adjust targets based on energy and evidence.
Confirm the save location before asking an agent to create planning files.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to create vague outcome goals without daily behaviors.
Do not treat coaching output as professional financial, legal, medical, or mental health advice.
Do not save coaching files into sensitive system or credential directories.

faq.question: Does this skill require Claude Code?
faq.answer: No. It supports Claude Code, Claude.ai, and other assistants through conversational prompts.

faq.question: What does the skill create?
faq.answer: It can create an annual plan, coaching context, and first weekly process plan in Markdown.

faq.question: Will it automatically write files?
faq.answer: It should ask where to save files first. Confirm the path before any file creation.

faq.question: Is it only for executives?
faq.answer: No. Founders, creators, managers, and individual contributors can use the process goal workflow.

faq.question: Does it track activity automatically?
faq.answer: No. It only recommends a companion tracking skill for users who want focus-time analysis.

faq.question: Can it guarantee goal achievement?
faq.answer: No. It provides structure and accountability, but results depend on execution and changing conditions.
